arjun: Hey team — onboarding a prod tenant in eu-west-2 and we've run into apparent SNAT port exhaustion on the hub NAT during GPU fleet bringup. Symptoms: lots of RST/timeout, repeated retries from provisioning jobs. I spun a TGW hub + 3 spokes, NAT GW in hub AZs, but one AZ is saturated. Need advice + quota asks (EIPs / ENIs / GPU).

maria: Can you share peak concurrent flows and NAT metrics? also the AWS account id for the quota request.

arjun: Peak concurrent TCP ephemeral sockets ~120k (mostly short lived). NATGW per-AZ but one AZ hit a hard limit ~65k flows. AWS acct: 123456789012. Tentative GPU request: +12 p4d (A100) capacity in eu-west-2 for the initial cluster. We also need more EIPs per region and ENI quota for the instance density.

sam-infra: Yep, classic SNAT exhaustion. Options: 1) increase EIP quota and create multiple NAT GW per-AZ (distribute flows), 2) move to a managed NAT appliance (GWLB + 3rd-party NAT) with autoscale, or 3) use NAT instances behind an NLB to get more source ports. Short-term I'd create 2x NAT GW per problematic AZ and add EIPs. Long-term consider GWLB + vendor.

petra-neteng: For TGW design, ensure AZ affinity so spokes prefer a same-AZ NAT in the hub. Route tables per-spoke with next-hop to NAT attachment per AZ helps keep traffic local and avoid cross-AZ hairpinning (reduces port concentration). Also request VPC Endpoint Interface quotas for PrivateLink (we'll need ECR/SSM endpoints for secure marketplace downloads).

arjun: Terraform snippet I'm testing to spin nat_count per az: ```hcl
variable "nat_per_az" { default = 2 }
resource "aws_eip" "nat" {
  count = var.nat_per_az * length(var.availability_zones)
  vpc   = true
}
resource "aws_nat_gateway" "nat" {
  count         = var.nat_per_az * length(var.availability_zones)
  allocation_id = aws_eip.nat[count.index].id
  subnet_id     = element(var.public_subnets, floor(count.index / var.nat_per_az))
}
# route table entries create 1:1 mapping from spoke->az-specific nat gateway
```

cloud-support-bot: Support ticket created: AWS-987654. Quota increase request submitted: Elastic IPs + ENI per-region + EC2 On-Demand p4d instances. Estimated response 48-72 hours.

deploy-bot: Note: provisioning job `gpu-cluster-bootstrap` failed 3 retries due to connection resets (see logs: `curl: (56) Recv failure: Connection reset by peer`).

maria: Also request ENI limits and VPC endpoint interface quota bump for eu-west-2 (PrivateLink endpoints for ECR, SSM, and marketplace). If you plan >10 p4d nodes, request ENI/IPv4-per-eni increases too.

arjun: Copy. Filing consolidated AWS support ticket with metrics + sample logs and terraform plan. I'll provision an extra NAT GW per AZ as a stop-gap tonight. @sam-infra @petra-neteng can we do a short design sync tomorrow 10:00 CET to lock final approach? :thumbsup:
